library: Cable clips, ties and energy chains
about: Commercial cable clips and holders (HellermannTyton HP plastic P-clamps, MB self-adhesive tie mounts, T-series cable ties) and igus e-chains (energy chains / cable carriers): the sizes from the makers' catalogues and product pages (links per part; the makers' CAD files are not copied here). Each clip carries its cable frame (cable: the axis the cable runs along, the Ø range) and its mounting (mount: the face it sits on, the screw); a chain carries its link sizes (chain) — web/js/library/cableparts.js places clips on a harness point and lays a chain out as a U.
